info.description: Canonical API for the Autonomous AI Research and Manuscript Generation Platform. All public paths are relative to /v1.
info.title: Research Platform API

get.description: Issue a short-lived signed URL after authorization. Restricted artifacts are audited.

post.description: A changed qualifier, number, population or causal strength is a new claim; verification reopens.
Record human checks and/or request a model-assisted support assessment, then re-evaluate under policy.
Queue a controlled fetch of an official CFP URL (nothing is fetched by the API itself).
Register a succeeded, independently recomputed run as a platform result (assessed like any other result).

get.description: Frozen inputs for a generation task: the brief and the base version it was requested against.
Which provider the token's project selected; for 'anthropic', the owner's key (audited, never logged).

post.description: Called by the project coordinator workflow when the project waits on a human decision.

Persist source-linked rules. Contradictions, missing timezones and unverified quotes stay
needs_human_resolution; a changed rule supersedes its predecessor and invalidates dependent confirmations.
Coordinator workflow's durable daily timer: schedule CFP monitoring and deadline reminders.

get.description:
Inputs for the gap agent, restricted by item rights: publisher-copyright abstracts and passages from papers
whose licence forbids model use are withheld (their metadata still counts as closest-work candidates).

post.description: Persist passages; the API re-verifies every quote verbatim against the committed source text.
The only path by which workflows advance canonical state. Stale/duplicate requests never overwrite.

get.description: Meta-review input: available only after every function froze its own report.
Each function receives only its own inputs - never another function's report (Reviewer Independence Policy).

patch.description: Human edit. Changed spans become human-authored and protected from regeneration.

post.description:
Apply a generated candidate. Rejected with 409 when the manuscript changed since generation started, or when
it would touch human-authored spans: those require an explicit merge.
Researcher-approved merge against the *current* version; protected human spans are always kept.

get.description: Contract version, required product copy and the canonical transition table.

post.description: In-product approval by the author themself, or an offline attestation recorded by the corresponding author.
Explicit human decision to change the cost ceiling (never automatic).
CFP gate: the researcher confirms the track and every blocking rule against the official snapshot.
Researcher-supplied official document with recorded provenance (used when fetching is not possible).

get.description: Rows per research question; drafts come from the H1 direction and committed results and require review.

post.description: Validated contribution (file type, size, malware scan, rights, PII class). Recorded in the ledger.
Project-owner attestation that project data may flow to a model/provider (§8).
H1: the researcher's substantive decision on question, intended contribution and method.

get.description: Latest recorded assessment plus a live re-evaluation (a deadline may have passed since it was recorded).

post.description: H4: the corresponding author signs the frozen content manifest after the pre-approval assessment.

get.description: Versioned coverage assessment derived only from stored search, screening and evidence records.

post.description:
Record a required method stage. Outputs are validated deterministically; prose alone cannot complete a stage
whose validator requires linked contributions or assessed results.
Version-locked package. Before H4 it is built for author review and visibly marked unapproved.
Manual citation entry. Identity stays unverified until a deterministic lookup confirms it.

Researcher-entered passage. Verified verbatim against stored text when the licence allowed storage;
otherwise recorded as a researcher quote that machine checks cannot confirm.
H2: freeze this exact protocol version. Execution and results are bound to its hash.
Record that independent review was not performed (e.g. no model configured) and why; shown at H2/H4.
A coded segment must quote its source verbatim (source-to-code trace).

patch.description: Researcher edits create a new rationale version (the agent draft is preserved) and a ledger entry.

post.description: Versioned Submission Readiness Assessment; never hides outstanding manual checks.
Researcher-supplied result manifest; must be bound to the frozen protocol hash. Assessed deterministically.
H3: the researcher validates actual outcomes, interpretation and limitations.
Observed-result claim linked to a committed result artifact; wording is limited by the assurance level.
Reproducibility appendix: exact queries, sources, dates, counts, decisions with reasons, forms, amendments.
Screening decisions are human decisions; an exclusion must use a reason from the frozen protocol.
Execute every search of the frozen specification exactly as written (query, provider, dates).
Deterministic synthesis computed by the platform from the current extraction records.

Select (or switch) the study type and venue category. A switch creates a new method-workflow instance and
reopens H1 and everything downstream; prior H2/H3 approvals never transfer.
Request cancellation of one queued/running task; Temporal runs its compensation. Committed artifacts are kept.
Re-run a failed or cancelled task from its recorded, versioned inputs as a new task (history is kept).
Researcher-supplied template with declared origin (used when the official link cannot be fetched).
Template exit criterion: snapshot recorded, adapter available, clean sample compile, mode confirmed.

get.description: Provider rights registry (public metadata only; never credentials).

post.description:
Only a human researcher resolves findings. Blockers cannot be accepted as risks; missing or contradicting
evidence must be fixed. 'fixed' requires a newer committed version, which the next review round re-checks.
Automatic revision is limited to two cycles; the result is a candidate the researcher must apply or merge.
Add an existing account to this workspace (admin with MFA only).
